Implementation Plan Implementation plan: load the workflow overlay from a trusted source (issue refs #3576, finding `pr-head-replaces-merge-judge-prompt`) Planning ref: `ai/issue-5824` @ `a31c945cd5e759081ff40edc5f3fcc6ea55509a5`. This matches the integration-branch metadata. Interpreted answers: - **Q1 = A.** Review/autofix and validate load `.github/ai/WORKFLOW.md` and its `append_path`/`replace_path` fragments from the repository's default branch. The run fetches that branch itself, pins it to one SHA, and copies the files into a runner-private directory. It never reads them from the PR or integration checkout. - **Q2 = A.** `render_prompt.py` refuses `replace_path` for prompts that decide merges and logs a warning. `append_path` is still applied. - **Q3 = B.** The fix goes in the shared overlay load in `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh`, which covers both the review path and the validate path. Contract tests cover both. Other workflows that call the loader (clarify, plan, implement, orchestrate*) keep their current loader call. They do pick up the Q2 check, because that check lives in the shared `render_prompt.py`. Scope-mode: Hold Scope Reuse-audit: extends load_workflow_overlay.py Scope-mode justification: The fix extends the existing overlay mechanism and adds no new script or workflow. `scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py` gets an opt-in trusted-source mode. Both overlay calls in `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` (review at line ~164, validate in `run_overlay_loader` at line ~821) switch to it. `render_prompt.py::apply_workflow_overlay`, the single place where overlays are applied, gets the per-mode `replace_path` check. Putting the default-branch fetch in the Python loader instead of a new shell helper means no new file has to be registered in `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` or the validate manifest. It also makes the logic directly testable, because both callers already stage the loader from the verified support commit. Completeness counts toward correctness (§6: Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed). So the plan also covers the symlink/escape fragment checks and the validate schema source, which add only a few lines each. Automation / §20 surface - No new script and no new workflow file. Existing code is extended: `scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py`, `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` and `scripts/render_prompt.py`. - Entry points are unchanged: - `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, step "Stage workflow support files", runs `bash .codex-workflow-src/scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` on `pull_request` / `workflow_dispatch`. - `.github/workflows/validate.yml` runs `stage_workflow_support.sh validate --manifest ...` on `workflow_call` / `workflow_dispatch`. - Neither workflow YAML needs an edit. `review_autofix.yml` stays at 449,442 bytes, below the 480,000-byte guard (§24). - No long-running supervisor, no DB work, and no `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry. - Rollout note: in this repo, review runs the helpers from the verified workflow SHA (main). The new behaviour therefore takes effect for reviews only after this change reaches `main`, and for consumers after the next `@stable` release. Every new input the helper reads has a default inside the helper (§8). 1. Files likely to change - `scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py`: add the trusted-source mode. - `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh`: - Review path (`stage_review_runtime_support`, lines ~162-167): call the loader in trusted mode. - Validate path (`run_overlay_loader`, lines ~819-828): call the loader in trusted mode, with the schema taken from the support root. - `scripts/render_prompt.py` (`apply_workflow_overlay`, line ~1284): refuse `replace_path` for merge-deciding modes. - `tests/test_workflow_overlay_core.py`: new behaviour tests and contract tests. - `tests/test_validate_workflow_validate_bootstrap.py` (`test_stage_workflow_support_helper_runs_overlay_loader_for_validate`, line ~122): update the expected strings. - `README.md` (line ~329, optional `.github/ai` surfaces) and `agents.md` (line ~810, `.github/ai/WORKFLOW.md` bullet): document where review and validate now load the overlay from, and the judge `replace_path` rule. - `changelog.d/-review-overlay-trusted-source.md`: one fragment (CLAUDE.md §20 format). 2. Functions / modules to implement A. `scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py` - New optional CLI arguments (existing ones are kept; `--repo-root` stays required for compatibility): - `--trusted-source-repo OWNER/REPO`: turns on trusted mode. - `--trusted-source-branch NAME`: optional. If empty, the loader reads `.repository.default_branch` from the JSON at `$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`. If that is also missing, it uses `git ls-remote --symref HEAD`. - `--trusted-root DIR`: required when trusted mode is on. It is the runner-private directory the files are copied into, and it is created and emptied first. - New function `fetch_trusted_overlay_source(repo, branch, git_dir) -> sha`: - Run `git init --bare` in a temporary git dir under the trusted root's parent. - Fetch with `git fetch --no-tags --depth 1 --filter=blob:none refs/heads/`. The URL is `${GITHUB_SERVER_URL:-https://github.com}/`, without a trailing slash. - If `GH_TOKEN` is set, pass authentication through environment config, not argv and not the remote URL: `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1`, `GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=http.extraHeader`, `GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=Authorization: Basic base64(x-access-token:)`. Lazy blob fetches by later `git show` calls inherit it. - Pin the result with `git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD` and use that one SHA for every read. - New function `materialize_trusted_file(git_dir, sha, rel_path, trusted_root)`: - Check the path with `git ls-tree -- `. Only mode `100644`/`100755` blobs are accepted. Symlinks (`120000`) and submodules raise `WorkflowOverlayLoadError`. A missing path returns `False`. - Write the content from `git show :` under `trusted_root/`. - Reject absolute paths, `..` segments, and any resolved destination outside `trusted_root`. - In `main()`, the trusted branch: 1. Fetch and pin the SHA. 2. Copy `.github/ai/WORKFLOW.md`. If it is absent, export the existing disabled values (`render_export_values(overlay_enabled=False, ...)`) and exit 0. 3. Parse and validate it with the existing `extract_front_matter` → `parse_front_matter` → `validate_payload_against_schema` → `coerce_prompt_overrides` chain, using `repo_root=trusted_root`. 4. Copy every `append_path`/`replace_path` fragment. 5. Export with `repo_root=trusted_root`, so `WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_REPO_ROOT` points at the trusted copy. 6. Log `::notice::WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_SOURCE mode=trusted repo= branch= sha= overlay=present|absent fragments=`. - Fail closed to "no overlay": if the branch cannot be resolved, the fetch fails, or git is missing, write the disabled exports, print `::warning::WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_SOURCE mode=trusted outcome=disabled reason=<...>` (without the token), and return 0. The checkout copy is never used as a fallback. - An overlay on the default branch that is invalid, or a fragment that is unsafe (symlink or escaping path), still exits 1, as an invalid overlay does today. - Without `--trusted-source-repo`, behaviour is byte-identical to today, so callers outside this scope are unaffected. B. `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` - Review path: replace `--repo-root "${workspace_root}"` with `--repo-root "${workspace_root}" --trusted-source-repo "${CURRENT_REPOSITORY}" --trusted-root "${SUPPORT_ROOT_DIR}/workflow-overlay"`. `SUPPORT_ROOT_DIR` is runner-private and persists for the job. `CURRENT_REPOSITORY` falls back to `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`. The schema path stays `${SUPPORT_AI_MEMORY_DIR}/schemas/...`. Update the comment to say the overlay is read from the default branch, never from the PR head. - Validate path (`run_overlay_loader`): - Add `--trusted-source-repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"` and `--trusted-root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/workflow-overlay-trusted-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"`. It must not go under `SUPPORT_STAGE_ROOT`, because that directory is removed by the EXIT trap and `render_prompt` runs in later steps. - Take the schema from `${SUPPORT_PRIMARY_ROOT}/ai-memory/schemas/workflow_overlay.v1.json` when that file exists. Otherwise keep the staged `ai-memory/schemas/...` path. Today `schema_files_if_missing` lets a copy in the target checkout win. - Fail with `::error::` if `RUNNER_TEMP`, `GITHUB_RUN_ID`, `GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT` or `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` is unset. C. `scripts/render_prompt.py` - Add the constant `OVERLAY_REPLACE_DENIED_MODE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^mode-(?:judge(?:-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?|orchestrate-poll-judge)$")` and a helper `_overlay_replace_denied(mode_name) -> bool`. - In `apply_workflow_overlay`, when the matching override has `replace_path` and the mode is denied: - print `::warning::WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_REPLACE_REJECTED mode= path=

` to stderr (never stdout, because `--assemble-only` writes the prompt to stdout); - return the stock fragment unchanged. - `append_path` for those modes is still applied. - Mode names come from the prompt stem (`render_prompt.sh` / `assemble_prompt.sh` pass `MODE_NAME="${PROMPT_BASENAME%.*}"`). The covered names are therefore `mode-judge`, `mode-judge-review-blocked`, `mode-judge-interim`, `mode-judge-security-pass-exhaustion`, `mode-judge-stall-recovery` and `mode-orchestrate-poll-judge`. 3. Data structures affected - `$GITHUB_ENV` exports keep the same names and shapes (`WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_ENABLED`, `WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_PROMPT_OVERRIDES_JSON`, `WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_REPO_ROOT`). Only the value of `WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_REPO_ROOT` changes, to the trusted copy, for review and validate. - No schema change (`workflow_overlay.v1.json` is untouched). No new env var is required. 4.
